what: A groovebox firmware based on SLOOP: three synth tracks and drums, a step sequencer and song mode. Its own SYNTH MODE (hold ENV): three wavetable oscillators, an envelope and an LFO for each, and an FX chain you build. Effects in parallel with an EQ and a soft clipper on every track, a glue compressor on the master, and the scale lit on the keys.
